fields.why: Binge drinks per binge drinker are measured in each of 4 education, 4 income, 5 age and 5 race/ethnicity groups, and the text ranks percentage increases across education and income groups ('largest').
Education and income are SES; sex is a pair and state is not an SPD.

The orthogonal-polynomial t-tests assess the linear year trend within each subgroup, a non-SPD contrast run within SPD levels (rule 6); trends and levels across groups are only ranked or shown, with no interaction or across-group test. The four mechanical flags are false alarms.
